measurement_rule.isolation: one fresh process per (engine, precision, batch) point
measurement_rule.stop_rule: first oom/error/timeout ends that engine's ascent

engine_paths.opennn: GPU-resident data, device gather, CUDA graphs
engine_paths.pytorch: autocast + torch.compile(mode=reduce-overhead) of the whole train step + Adam(fused=True)
engine_paths.tensorflow: mixed_bfloat16 + tf.function(jit_compile=True) over the whole step
